nodes.title: Sampling profiles

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Sampling profiles

> Choose the profile in the **Director**. The sampling graph follows it automatically.

- **Base Quality / Balanced:** native H3 with no acceleration file
- **LightX v0.1:** four-step accelerated recipe
- **PDD 600 / 900:** four-step REF2VA students and requires the PDD node package

## Frame extraction

The temporal quality setting controls the H3 frame packet. The selector then returns the recommended still.

*Decode tuning is documented beside the decode controls.*

# Benchmark Lab

> **Optional:** use this only when comparing quality or speed.

1. Enter sampling profiles and resolution targets.
2. Check the exact generation count on the node.
3. Turn **Benchmark ON** in the purple Run mode switch.

**Same seed** is the fairest comparison. *New seeds* are better for diversity sweeps. Disable live cells when you only care about throughput.

nodes.title: Reference semantics

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Reference semantics

> **Explicit card metadata always wins** over automatic inference.

## Common roles

- **identity / character** + `fully_preserved`: keep the person or design
- **style** + `attribute_transfer`: borrow rendering language, not content
- **composition / layout:** borrow placement and hierarchy
- **outfit, pose, typography, lighting, texture, object, environment:** narrow transfers

*Give each reference one clear visual job whenever possible.*

nodes.title: Native H3 VAE decode

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Native H3 VAE decode

> **Start with Auto.** It keeps the proven native `256 / 64` geometry and chooses tile batching from available VRAM.

## Manual controls

- **Tile size:** `256`, `320`, `384`, `512`
- **Overlap:** `64`, `96`, `128`
- **Tile batch:** `Auto`, `1`, `2`, `4`

**Larger tiles** use more VRAM but reduce tile count. *Smaller tiles* are safer when memory is tight.

> **Quality warning:** Manual tile geometry changes the VAE's spatial context. Too little overlap, especially with larger tiles such as `512 / 64`, can cause visible degradation, softer detail, texture loss, or tile boundaries. If you increase tile size, increase overlap as well. For example, prefer `512 / 128` over `512 / 64`.

> Change Manual values only when tuning or benchmarking. **Auto** is the compatibility default.

nodes.title: START HERE · quick setup

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Start here

> **Fast path:** describe the final image, add only references that have a specific job, then queue.

## Make an image

1. Write naturally in the **Director**.
2. Add references only when needed. They become ordered `@Image1`, `@Image2`, and so on.
3. Choose role, retention, aspect ratio, resolution, and seed.
4. Queue the workflow.

*No references* uses FL2VA text-to-image. **Multiple references** use REF2VA.

nodes.title: Prompt enhancement

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Prompt enhancement

> *Two separate Qwen stages are used only when you enable them.*

## Image analysis

- **Analyze image pixels:** Qwen3-VL creates factual source descriptions and can repair automatic roles.

## Prompt writing

- **Prompt enhancement:** a compact text-only pass turns the request plus reference facts into a production prompt.

**Same as image analyzer** lets one loaded checkpoint perform both jobs. Choose a separate writer only when you intentionally want to stage another model.

nodes.title: Routing

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Routing

> **Auto is the recommended default.**

- **0 references:** FL2VA text-to-image
- **1 anchor:** FL2VA image editing when requested
- **Multiple references:** REF2VA

*Forced routes are diagnostic controls.* Invalid reference and route combinations are rejected before model work starts.

nodes.title: Why the Director stays visible

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Why the Director stays visible

> The **Director** owns rich Studio state, reference cards, and `@Image` editing.

The reusable sampling graph only owns ordinary typed sampling and decode sockets. Keeping that boundary visible avoids fragile promoted DOM widgets and keeps the main path readable.

**UI state stays here.** *Sampling stays reusable.*

nodes.title: Model downloads

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
# Recommended model set

> **Recommended:** use **H3 Studio · Model Setup** on the left. Download also the custom node "Universal Asset Downloader" for easier process. Core runtime models and acceleration LoRAs are separated there, with exact paths, sizes, verification and safe UAD downloads. The links below remain the manual fallback.

## Core models

- **FL2VA base** · [Kijai pruned W4A8](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_w4a8_mixed.safetensors?download=true) → `diffusion_models/`
- **REF2VA base** · [Kijai pruned W4A8](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/resolve/main/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_w4a8_mixed.safetensors?download=true) → `diffusion_models/`
- **H3 text encoder** · [Qwen3-VL 32B NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors?download=true) → `text_encoders/`
- **Original final VAE** · [H3 Video VAE FP16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors?download=true) → `vae/`
- **Prompt analyzer / writer** · [Qwen3-VL 4B](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors?download=true) → `text_encoders/`

## Recommended acceleration profiles

> **FL2VA only.** Use these for text-to-image or a single-source FL2VA edit.

- **LightX v1.0 · 8-step · official full** · [`minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors`](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors?download=true) → `loras/`
- **LightX v1.0 · 8-step · Kijai pruned rank-24** · [smaller equivalent](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_resized_avg_rank_24_bf16.safetensors?download=true) → `loras/`
- **LightX v1.0 · 4-step 768p · Kijai pruned rank-31** · [speed profile](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_resized_avg_rank_31_bf16.safetensors?download=true) → `loras/`

## Alternative / pruned acceleration models

- **FL2VA · LightX v0.1 · 4-step · Kijai pruned rank-21** · [ER-SDE / SA-Solver profile artifact](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfy_resized_avg_rank_21_bf16.safetensors?download=true) → `loras/`
- **REF2VA · LightX v0.1 · 4-step · Kijai pruned rank-20** · [reference-generation artifact](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_resized_avg_rank_20_bf16.safetensors?download=true) → `loras/`

> The REF2V profile is rejected on FL2VA routes. Switch **Mode** to Reference mix/edit and use Auto/REF2VA. FL2V profiles are likewise rejected on REF2VA.

## Preview / VAE extras

- **TAEH3 live preview** · [`taeh3.safetensors`](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/resolve/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors?download=true) → `vae_approx/`
- **Experimental T=1 Image VAE** · [`minimax_h3_t1_image_vae_step1597.safetensors`](https://huggingface.co/Mamad8/MiniMax-H3-Image-VAE/resolve/main/minimax_h3_t1_image_vae_step1597.safetensors?download=true) → `vae/`
- **Optional Qwen3-VL 8B writer** · [`qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors?download=true) → `text_encoders/`

## PDD · optional REF2VA acceleration

Choose either the **600** or **900** LoRA + heads pair and install [Mamad8's PDD custom node](https://github.com/mamad8c/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-PDD-Mamad8). PDD is REF2VA-only.

The target image is an authentic early-2000s TV broadcast anime still, perfectly capturing the classic Studio Pierrot 2D cel-animation style. The camera provides a wide, deep-focus establishing shot of the iconic red arched wooden bridge in the Hidden Leaf Village. A calm, stylized blue river flows beneath it, surrounded by lush green trees and traditional wooden village architecture in the hazy, warm light of early morning. The composition spreads the three young genin across the wide frame to highlight their differing personalities.

h3studio_prompt_reference_doc.text:
summary:
[image generation] A classic 16:9 wide-angle 2D anime broadcast still, replicating a nostalgic, comedic downtime scene of Team 7 waiting for their sensei in an early-2000s "Naruto" episode.

detailed_description:
The target image is an authentic early-2000s TV broadcast anime still, perfectly capturing the classic Studio Pierrot 2D cel-animation style. The aesthetic features crisp, thin ink linework, flat cel shading without modern digital gradients, slightly soft DVD-era image quality, and a highly detailed, hand-painted watercolor background. 

The camera provides a wide, deep-focus establishing shot of the iconic red arched wooden bridge in the Hidden Leaf Village. A calm, stylized blue river flows beneath it, surrounded by lush green trees and traditional wooden village architecture in the hazy, warm light of early morning. The composition spreads the three young genin across the wide frame to highlight their differing personalities.

In the dead center of the wooden bridge planks, 12-year-old Naruto Uzumaki (in his bright orange and blue jumpsuit) is lying completely flat on his back in a starfish pose, fast asleep. A classic, translucent anime snot-bubble is expanding from his nose. 

On the far left, Sakura Haruno (in her red qipao dress) is slumped heavily over the red wooden railing, her arms dangling loosely toward the water. Her head is hung in total exhaustion, with a comical, oversized blue anime sweat-drop graphic painted on her forehead.

On the right side of the frame, Sasuke Uchiha (in his blue high-collar shirt and white shorts) sits precariously on the top of the wooden railing. He has one knee drawn up to his chest, resting his chin on his folded hands, glaring down at the river with a profound, brooding scowl of intense irritation.

In the far background, perfectly centered down the dirt path leading to the bridge, the tiny figure of Kakashi Hatake can be seen slowly strolling toward them. He is completely unbothered, his face buried in his small orange book. 

Synchronized yellow English subtitles with a crisp black drop-shadow appear centered near the bottom edge, reading: "I can't believe he's three hours late..." The scene evokes the genuine, lighthearted character dynamics and world-building of the classic anime era.
